requirements.name: Company Overview
requirements.description: AWS Partner has a company overview presentation covering company history, locations, employees, customer profile, service differentiators, and AWS relationship details

requirements.name: MSP Practice Growth
requirements.description: AWS Partner is actively growing their MSP Practice with ≥4 new customer contracts or addenda demonstrating growth within last 18 months

requirements.name: Financial Planning and Reporting
requirements.description: AWS Partner has processes for financial planning including forecasting, budgeting, and review of financial metrics

requirements.name: Go-To-Market
requirements.description: AWS Partner has documented processes for identifying MSP opportunities, training sellers, and generating demand/leads

requirements.name: Personnel Onboarding
requirements.description: AWS Partner has defined onboarding processes and checklists for personnel relevant to MSP practice

requirements.name: Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE)
requirements.description: AWS Partner maintains a CCOE covering cloud adoption, training, governance, strategy, and operations/automation

requirements.name: Personnel Offboarding
requirements.description: AWS Partner has defined termination processes ensuring all access to customer and Partner systems is revoked

requirements.name: Risk and Mitigation Plans
requirements.description: Business risks including AWS practice are outlined with documented mitigation plans

requirements.name: Customer Satisfaction
requirements.description: AWS Partner has mechanism to objectively capture customer satisfaction via surveys, post-interaction feedback, or review meetings

requirements.name: Data Ownership and Customer Offboarding
requirements.description: Customer contracts define data ownership, data transfer procedures, timeframes, and offboarding process

requirements.name: Operational Readiness
requirements.description: AWS Partner has Operational Readiness process with checklists for personnel, tools, and operational processes

requirements.name: Shared Responsibility Model
requirements.description: AWS Partner defines security requirements and operational expectations via RACI matrix between Partner and Customer

requirements.name: Sustainability Best Practices
requirements.description: AWS Partner optimizes workload placement and architecture for energy efficiency

requirements.name: Account Management
requirements.description: AWS accounts are not shared across customers (except multi-tenant SaaS products owned by Partner)

requirements.name: Solution Capabilities
requirements.description: Detailed design documents for 2 customers reviewed by AWS certified Solutions Architect, including requirements and architecture

requirements.name: Non-Functional Requirements
requirements.description: Design documents include performance, capacity, availability requirements, SLAs, monitoring approach, and testing process

requirements.name: Well-Architected
requirements.description: Design documents show customer infrastructure is well-architected per AWS Well-Architected Framework with zero HRIs in Security, Operational Excellence, and Reliability pillars

requirements.name: AWS Service Expertise
requirements.description: Two customer workloads each using ≥4 AWS services beyond basic compute/network/storage (exempt with 3+ Competencies/Service Deliveries)

requirements.name: Security Policies and Procedures
requirements.description: Established security policies and procedures to protect Partner systems, reviewed and approved by management

requirements.name: Security Awareness Training
requirements.description: MSP Practice employees complete annual security awareness training

requirements.name: AWS Account Configuration
requirements.description: Standard security controls implemented for all managed environments per Appendix A minimum configuration

requirements.name: Identity and Access Management
requirements.description: Centralized identity provider for managing access to all AWS accounts and customer data systems

requirements.name: Policy Management
requirements.description: Mechanism to evaluate and restrict permissions including IAM Access Analyzer reviews performed multiple times in last 12 months

requirements.name: Role-Based Access
requirements.description: All Partner access to AWS accounts uses temporary credentials via IAM roles following least privilege

requirements.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
requirements.description: All human access to AWS accounts requires MFA

requirements.name: Vulnerability Management
requirements.description: Vulnerability scanning functionality to evaluate security and compliance of AWS infrastructure

requirements.name: Security Event Logging
requirements.description: Defines logging requirements with customers, captures security events, and ensures retention periods are honored

requirements.name: SaaS Tooling Account Access
requirements.description: Third-party SaaS tools accessing customer AWS accounts use IAM Roles with external IDs

requirements.name: Service Level Management
requirements.description: Defines SLAs for service offerings including response times, remediation times, and change turnaround with review process

requirements.name: AWS Support Plan (Partner Accounts)
requirements.description: All Organizations management and production member accounts have Business, Enterprise, or PLS Support

requirements.name: AWS Support Plan (Customer Accounts)
requirements.description: Communicates value of AWS Premium Support, recommends Business/Enterprise for production, documents risks for opt-outs

requirements.name: Service Desk Operations
requirements.description: 24x7 service desk function available via multiple communication means with documented after-hours procedures

requirements.name: ITSM Platform
requirements.description: Comprehensive ITSM platform with incident/problem management, change management, service requests, reporting, and automation integration

requirements.name: Release Management
requirements.description: Comprehensive release management with version control, testing procedures, approval system, and IaC deployment

requirements.name: Configuration Management
requirements.description: Records of environment configuration changes with unified view of resources, timestamps, status, individual, and approval

requirements.name: Patch Management
requirements.description: Automated patching process for OS, applications, and security/compliance patches

requirements.name: Customer Deployment Pipelines
requirements.description: Supports automated deployments and rollbacks without manual involvement (manual approvals acceptable)

requirements.name: Event Management and Dynamic Monitoring
requirements.description: Define, monitor, and analyze workload/infrastructure health KPIs with metrics, logs, traces, alarms, and dashboards

requirements.name: Operational Runbooks
requirements.description: Runbooks for responding to specific workload/infrastructure/security alerts

requirements.name: Anomaly Detection
requirements.description: Statistical or ML anomaly detection models across infrastructure and application metrics to reduce false positives

requirements.name: Predictive Monitoring and AIOps
requirements.description: Predictive models that identify trends and alert before anomalies or threshold breaches (Recommended)

requirements.name: Knowledge Management
requirements.description: Knowledge management system for operational processes and customer workload details with content lifecycle

requirements.name: Disaster Recovery
requirements.description: Automated backups and recovery tests for all workloads against predefined RTO/RPO

requirements.name: Cloud Financial Management
requirements.description: Methodology and tooling for TCO analysis, cloud spend monitoring, and customer-specific rate billing

requirements.name: Migrations
requirements.description: Capabilities for migrating/modernizing workloads using standard methodology covering portfolio discovery, governance, people/skills, landing zone, operations, security, and application migration (exempt with Migration Competency)

requirements.name: Artificial Intelligence
requirements.description: Use of Generative AI for internal operations or customer projects (Recommended)
